001package com.streamConverter.test;
002
003import java.io.File;
004import java.io.IOException;
005import java.nio.file.Files;
006import java.nio.file.Path;
007import java.nio.file.Paths;
008import java.util.ArrayList;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.stream.Stream;
011import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
012import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
013import javax.xml.parsers.ParserConfigurationException;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

017import org.w3c.dom.Element;
018import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;

021/**
022 * Utility class to analyze test failures from XML test reports
023 *
024 * <p>This class parses JUnit XML test reports and extracts detailed failure information for easier
025 * debugging and analysis.
026 */
027public class TestFailureAnalyzer {
028  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TestFailureAnalyzer.class);
029
030  /** Private constructor to prevent instantiation of utility class */
031  private TestFailureAnalyzer() {
032    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Utility class should not be instantiated");
033  }
034
035  /** Represents a single test failure with detailed information */
036    public static class TestFailure {
037    private final String testClass;
038    private final String testMethod;
039    private final String failureType;
040    private final String failureMessage;
041    private final String stackTrace;
042    private final double executionTime;
043
044    /**
045     * Creates a new TestFailure instance with the provided details
046     *
047     * @param testClass the fully qualified name of the test class
048     * @param testMethod the name of the failed test method
049     * @param failureType the type of failure (e.g., AssertionError, NullPointerException)
050     * @param failureMessage the failure message
051     * @param stackTrace the complete stack trace of the failure
052     * @param executionTime the time in seconds the test took to execute
053     */
054      public TestFailure(
055          final String testClass,
056          final String testMethod,
057          final String failureType,
058          final String failureMessage,
059          final String stackTrace,
060          final double executionTime) {
061        this.testClass = testClass;
062        this.testMethod = testMethod;
063        this.failureType = failureType;
064        this.failureMessage = failureMessage;
065        this.stackTrace = stackTrace;
066        this.executionTime = executionTime;
067      }
068
069    /**
070     * Gets the fully qualified name of the test class
071     *
072     * @return the fully qualified name of the test class
073     */
074    public String getTestClass() {
075      return testClass;
076    }
077
078    /**
079     * Gets the name of the failed test method
080     *
081     * @return the name of the failed test method
082     */
083    public String getTestMethod() {
084      return testMethod;
085    }
086
087    /**
088     * Gets the type of failure
089     *
090     * @return the type of failure (e.g., AssertionError, NullPointerException)
091     */
092    public String getFailureType() {
093      return failureType;
094    }
095
096    /**
097     * Gets the failure message
098     *
099     * @return the failure message
100     */
101    public String getFailureMessage() {
102      return failureMessage;
103    }
104
105    /**
106     * Gets the complete stack trace of the failure
107     *
108     * @return the complete stack trace of the failure
109     */
110    public String getStackTrace() {
111      return stackTrace;
112    }
113
114    /**
115     * Gets the execution time for the test
116     *
117     * @return the time in seconds the test took to execute
118     */
119    public double getExecutionTime() {
120      return executionTime;
121    }
122
123      @Override
124      public String toString() {
125        return String.format(
126            "=== TEST FAILURE ===%nClass: %s%nMethod: %s%nExecution Time: %ss%nFailure Type: %s%nMessage: %s%nStack Trace:%n%s%n====================%n",
127            testClass,
128            testMethod,
129            executionTime,
130            failureType,
131            failureMessage,
132            stackTrace);
133      }
134  }
135
136  /** Represents a summary of test execution results including failure details */
137  public static class TestSummary {
138    private final int totalTests;
139    private final int failures;
140    private final int errors;
141    private final int skipped;
142    private final List<TestFailure> failureDetails;
143
144    /**
145     * Creates a new TestSummary instance
146     *
147     * @param totalTests the total number of tests executed
148     * @param failures the number of test failures
149     * @param errors the number of test errors
150     * @param skipped the number of skipped tests
151     * @param failureDetails list of detailed failure information
152     */
153      public TestSummary(
154          final int totalTests,
155          final int failures,
156          final int errors,
157          final int skipped,
158          final List<TestFailure> failureDetails) {
159        this.totalTests = totalTests;
160        this.failures = failures;
161        this.errors = errors;
162        this.skipped = skipped;
163        this.failureDetails = failureDetails;
164      }
165
166    /**
167     * Gets the total number of tests executed
168     *
169     * @return the total number of tests executed
170     */
171    public int getTotalTests() {
172      return totalTests;
173    }
174
175    /**
176     * Gets the number of test failures
177     *
178     * @return the number of test failures
179     */
180    public int getFailures() {
181      return failures;
182    }
183
184    /**
185     * Gets the number of test errors
186     *
187     * @return the number of test errors
188     */
189    public int getErrors() {
190      return errors;
191    }
192
193    /**
194     * Gets the number of skipped tests
195     *
196     * @return the number of skipped tests
197     */
198    public int getSkipped() {
199      return skipped;
200    }
201
202    /**
203     * Gets the list of detailed failure information
204     *
205     * @return list of detailed failure information
206     */
207    public List<TestFailure> getFailureDetails() {
208      return failureDetails;
209    }
210
211    /**
212     * Checks if there are any failures or errors
213     *
214     * @return true if there are any failures or errors
215     */
216    public boolean hasFailures() {
217      return failures > 0 || errors > 0;
218    }
219
220      @Override
221      public String toString() {
222        final String summary =
223            String.format(
224                "=== TEST SUMMARY ===%nTotal Tests: %d%nFailures: %d%nErrors: %d%nSkipped: %d%nSuccess Rate: %.1f%%%n====================%n",
225                totalTests,
226                failures,
227                errors,
228                skipped,
229                (totalTests - failures - errors) * 100.0 / totalTests);
230        String result = summary;
231        if (hasFailures()) {
232          final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(summary);
233          builder.append(System.lineSeparator());
234          for (final TestFailure failure : failureDetails) {
235            builder.append(failure).append(System.lineSeparator());
236          }
237          result = builder.toString();
238        }
239        return result;
240      }
241  }
242
243  /**
244   * Analyzes test results from XML reports in the given directory
245   *
246   * @param testResultsPath Path to test-results directory (e.g., "build/test-results/test")
247   * @return TestSummary containing failure details
248   * @throws IOException if unable to read test result files
249   */
250    public static TestSummary analyzeTestResults(final String testResultsPath) throws IOException {
251      final Path resultsDir = Paths.get(testResultsPath);
252
253    if (!Files.exists(resultsDir) || !Files.isDirectory(resultsDir)) {
254      throw new IOException("Test results directory not found: " + testResultsPath);
255    }
256
257      final List<TestFailure> allFailures = new ArrayList<>();
258    int totalTests = 0;
259    int totalFailures = 0;
260    int totalErrors = 0;
261    int totalSkipped = 0;
262
263    try (Stream<Path> xmlFiles = Files.list(resultsDir)) {
264        for (final Path xmlFile : xmlFiles.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).toList()) {
265          final TestSummary fileSummary = parseXmlTestReport(xmlFile.toFile());
266
267        totalTests += fileSummary.getTotalTests();
268        totalFailures += fileSummary.getFailures();
269        totalErrors += fileSummary.getErrors();
270        totalSkipped += fileSummary.getSkipped();
271        allFailures.addAll(fileSummary.getFailureDetails());
272      }
273    }
274
275    return new TestSummary(totalTests, totalFailures, totalErrors, totalSkipped, allFailures);
276  }
277
278  /**
279   * Parses a single XML test report file
280   *
281   * @param xmlFile XML test report file
282   * @return TestSummary for this file
283   */
284    public static TestSummary parseXmlTestReport(final File xmlFile) {
285      final List<TestFailure> failures = new ArrayList<>();
286      TestSummary summary;
287      try {
288        final DocumentBuilderFactory factory = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
289        final DocumentBuilder builder = factory.newDocumentBuilder();
290        final Document doc = builder.parse(xmlFile);
291
292        final Element testsuite = doc.getDocumentElement();
293        final int tests = Integer.parseInt(testsuite.getAttribute("tests"));
294        final int failureCount = Integer.parseInt(testsuite.getAttribute("failures"));
295        final int errorCount = Integer.parseInt(testsuite.getAttribute("errors"));
296        final int skippedCount = Integer.parseInt(testsuite.getAttribute("skipped"));
297
298        final NodeList testcases = testsuite.getElementsByTagName("testcase");
299
300        for (int i = 0; i < testcases.getLength(); i++) {
301          final Element testcase = (Element) testcases.item(i);
302          final String testClass = testcase.getAttribute("classname");
303          final String testMethod = testcase.getAttribute("name");
304          final double time = Double.parseDouble(testcase.getAttribute("time"));
305
306          // Check for failure
307          final NodeList failureNodes = testcase.getElementsByTagName("failure");
308          if (failureNodes.getLength() > 0) {
309            final Element failure = (Element) failureNodes.item(0);
310            final String failureType = failure.getAttribute("type");
311            final String failureMessage = failure.getAttribute("message");
312            final String failureStackTrace = failure.getTextContent();
313
314            failures.add(
315                new TestFailure(
316                    testClass, testMethod, failureType, failureMessage, failureStackTrace, time));
317          }
318
319          // Check for error
320          final NodeList errorNodes = testcase.getElementsByTagName("error");
321          if (errorNodes.getLength() > 0) {
322            final Element error = (Element) errorNodes.item(0);
323            final String errorType = error.getAttribute("type");
324            final String errorMessage = error.getAttribute("message");
325            final String errorStackTrace = error.getTextContent();
326
327            failures.add(
328                new TestFailure(testClass, testMethod, errorType, errorMessage, errorStackTrace, time));
329          }
330        }
331
332        summary = new TestSummary(tests, failureCount, errorCount, skippedCount, failures);
333
334      } catch (ParserConfigurationException | SAXException | IOException e) {
335        if (LOG.isErrorEnabled()) {
336          LOG.error("Failed to parse XML file: {}", xmlFile.getName(), e);
337        }
338        summary = new TestSummary(0, 0, 0, 0, new ArrayList<>());
339      }
340      return summary;
341    }
342
343  /**
344   * Main method for command-line usage
345   *
346   * <p>Usage: java TestFailureAnalyzer [test-results-path] If no path specified, uses
347   * "build/test-results/test"
348   *
349   * @param args command line arguments, optional test results path
350   */
351  public static void main(final String[] args) {
352    final String testResultsPath = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : "build/test-results/test";
353
354    try {
355      final TestSummary summary = analyzeTestResults(testResultsPath);
356      if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
357        LOG.info("{}", summary);
358      }
359
360      if (summary.hasFailures()) {
361        System.exit(1); // Exit with error code if there are failures
362      }
363
364    } catch (IOException e) {
365      LOG.error("Error analyzing test results", e);
366      System.exit(1);
367    }
368  }
369}
